title: Restart a user service
summary: Restart a background service that runs only for your user account, not the whole system. Useful for user-specific daemons like pipewire or user-level systemd timers.

steps.explain: Restart the specified user service. Replace <SERVICE> with the name of the user unit (e.g., pipewire, gpg-agent).

placeholders.name: SERVICE
placeholders.description: Name of the user systemd unit to restart

steps.expect: The command returns to the prompt without output if successful.
